ideas.title: The Tool Stack Lie Nobody Talks About
ideas.concept: Myth-bust post debunking the idea that more tools = better automation. Visual shows a cluttered dashboard with 15+ disconnected apps vs. a clean, integrated stack (Claude + N8N + GoHighLevel + Google Workspace). Copy explains why tool count doesn't matter—integration and workflow design do.
ideas.hook: You don't need 47 SaaS subscriptions. You need one thing: a brain that connects them.

ideas.title: The Lead Qualification Test That Saves 10 Hours/Week
ideas.concept: Tool breakdown/tutorial-style post featuring Claude AI running lead qualification on autopilot via N8N. Before/after visual shows inbox chaos vs. pre-qualified leads landing in GoHighLevel, sorted by fit and budget. Includes a 30-second workflow concept breakdown.
ideas.hook: Claude just read 40 inbound leads and ranked them by close probability. Your sales team got 10 hours back.

ideas.title: Why Your Competitor's Automation Died (And Yours Won't)
ideas.concept: Story-driven case study showing a real scenario: business owner implements N8N workflow, gets excited, ignores monitoring, workflow silently breaks after 6 weeks costing them deals. Post reveals the one audit habit that prevents this. Visual: simple timeline of the breakdown + the fix.
ideas.hook: Most automations don't fail because the tech is bad. They fail because nobody's watching.
